name: m109-r15-watchdog-boundary-off
rationale: 去掉 `_watch_round` 的判定路径异常边界：宿主钩子（镜像时 `asyncio.Future.done(<非 Future>)`的 `TypeError`）会逃出 done 回调，被 asyncio 的 `call_exception_handler` 吞掉（判定与结算若还没落地就是永久挂起）。杀死者：r15 的「镜像失败不许逃进事件循环」用例 + 兜底结算用例。
old:
try:
            self._judge_round(task, round_, future, judged)
        except BaseException as exc:                 # noqa: BLE001 - 见 docstring：判定绝不丢
            logger.debug("事件总线关停：判定路径抛异常（看门狗兜底，绝不挂起）: %r", exc)
            self._settle_unsettled_round(task, round_, future)
new: self._judge_round(task, round_, future, judged)  # mutation: 去掉判定路径的异常边界
